decision: Reconstruct independently of legacy files
rationale: The INEC cohort depends on official releases, not the availability of a previous analytic extract. The optional legacy comparison is a separate provenance question.
limitations: --compare-legacy still verifies the thesis baseline; absence of those files cannot validate a historical comparison.

decision: Select primary discharge diagnosis C71.0-C71.9
rationale: Use the source diagnosis field and exact normalized subcodes; exclude other neoplasms from this operational target.
limitations: C71-coded admissions are not histologically confirmed incident patients.

decision: Correct C71.4 and C71.7 placement
rationale: Occipital-lobe and brainstem codes must not inherit incompatible legacy labels.
limitations: The combined C71.5-C71.7 infratentorial/midline category remains a study-defined grouping; C71.5 is not universally infratentorial.

decision: Retain all eligible discharge records
rationale: No reliable patient linkage has been established; demographic equality cannot establish duplicate admissions. Retain repeated projections and count source records.
limitations: No patient deduplication or independent-event validation is claimed.

decision: Retain 2017 and 2023
rationale: The reconstructed releases contain 1221 and 1095 eligible admissions. Legacy low counts do not establish a national registration failure.
limitations: The mechanism of historical record losses is unknown; no pandemic or administrative causal claim follows.

decision: Recode discharge deaths from codes 2 and 3
rationale: Annual value labels distinguish alive, death before 48 hours and death at 48 hours or later.
limitations: Labels support the recode, not validation against medical records.

decision: Respect source age units and valid ranges
rationale: INEC labels specify hours 1-23, days 1-28, months 1-11 and years 1-115. Valid subyear ages have zero completed years; invalid values remain unknown.
limitations: Early-year application must remain auditable against each annual schema; no selected record is unclassifiable.

decision: Use mutually exclusive stay categories
rationale: Preserve recorded stay; assign day 30 only to 15-30 and use 31+ for the next group. Retain date discrepancies as audit fields.
limitations: No clinical threshold is validated; the inferred same-day minimum-one convention is descriptive, not proven from a manual.

decision: Preserve missing and unknown values
rationale: Unknown ethnicity is distinct from Other; covariate missingness does not remove otherwise eligible discharges at reconstruction.
limitations: This is not by itself a regression missing-data solution; T04 handling is documented separately; T05 primary and extended adjustment are explicitly distinguished.

decision: Separate residence, facility geography and sector
rationale: Use prov_res for resident eligibility; keep prov_ubi separately. Preserve three source sectors and explicitly label the binary aggregation.
limitations: Facility location is not resident origin; binary sector is not the only possible grouping.

decision: Flag unverified early rural/urban labels
rationale: The 2015-2017 residence-area interpretation lacks independent label confirmation. Preserve codes and provisional status.
limitations: No bibliographic assertion closes this gap. These labels are not used in Table 3.

decision: Match resident numerator to resident denominators
rationale: Exclude three foreign-resident live discharges only from primary population rates; keep them in the full cohort and sensitivity analysis.
limitations: The exact exclusion policy is our decision; sources define variables and the rate framework, not an Ecuador-specific mandated exclusion.

decision: Use annual midyear population denominators
rationale: Use national both-sex single-age estimates from Revision 2024 sheet 1.1 for each corresponding year.
limitations: Projected populations remain estimates; their uncertainty is not propagated into intervals.

decision: Use actual 2022 census standard weights
rationale: Normalize observed census age counts (16938986) to fixed weights, separately from annual population estimates.
limitations: Using Ecuador 2022 is a study choice consistent with the manuscript; it is not SEER's US standard or a universally preferred standard.

decision: Use five primary age bands plus narrower sensitivity
rationale: Keep the manuscript's 0-17, 18-44, 45-64, 65-79 and 80+ primary bands; also calculate 18 five-year/tail bands.
limitations: Broad bands can leave residual age differences. Agreement of overall means does not prove stability in each category.

decision: Calculate rates by direct standardization
rationale: Sum each year's age-specific discharge/death rates multiplied by the same fixed age weights; express per 100000.
limitations: The numerator is discharge events, so the result is not unique-patient incidence or all-cause cancer mortality.

decision: Use Fay-Feuer gamma rate intervals
rationale: Apply the weighted independent-Poisson construction with the maximum coefficient, including zero-event strata.
limitations: Independence and fixed denominators are assumptions; the paper does not validate them for these admissions.

decision: Define the mean and pooled summaries separately
rationale: The primary mean weights ten annual standardized rates equally; the alternative pools age-specific population-years. Mean intervals use coefficients divided by ten.
limitations: The primary mean is not a guideline-mandated estimator, a ten-year risk, or an average of interval endpoints.

decision: Calculate admission fatality with Wilson intervals
rationale: Use deaths/admissions and a binomial score interval; keep it separate from population-based standardized death rates.
limitations: Admission fatality is not patient survival; repeat admissions may violate binomial independence.

decision: Retain sparse estimates and label uncertainty
rationale: Flag annual event counts below ten, preserve zero-event upper limits, and avoid inferring significance from overlapping intervals.
limitations: Below ten is a local flag, not a cited universal suppression or reliability rule.

decision: Interpret intervals conditionally
rationale: State Poisson/binomial assumptions and omitted clustering, coding errors and demographic uncertainty; avoid causal trend conclusions.
limitations: No trend hypothesis test, clinical diagnostic validation or causal pandemic analysis has been performed.

decision: Freeze source bytes and record software versions
rationale: Use immutable archives, SHA-256 checks and scripted regeneration; preserve historical manifests rather than resetting expected hashes.
limitations: Byte identity is distinct from scientific correctness; small platform floating-point differences require numeric comparison.

decision: Verify table values and reconcile manuscript changes
rationale: Check source cells, independent formulas, component totals, mean definitions and displayed rounding; expose manuscript differences.
limitations: Published references justify methods; the local verification establishes the actual numbers. The old PDF and Figure 1 still need revision.

decision: Require evidence for subsequent changes
rationale: Record the change, rationale, source locator, result checks and unresolved assumptions before carrying it into manuscript claims.
limitations: T04 and T05 have their own specification/evidence; pending T06-T10 work is not validated by this register. Each later model, exclusion and interpretation needs its own evidence.

decision: Preserve completed T04 with its own evidence
rationale: Keep the death=1 rebuilt model and explicit SPV event-direction correction alongside the independently supported T01-T03 reconstruction.
support_type: Separately documented technical analysis and local validation
limitations: Patient/facility dependence and clinical specification review remain limitations. T05 has replaced the conventional multinomial table with two explicitly scoped binary analyses; the old model remains invalid.

decision: Separate recorded coding from conditional anatomy
rationale: Non-C719 coding and anatomical group among eligible recorded sites are distinct estimands.
support_type: Source-defined code meanings plus explicit study choice
limitations: Not diagnostic accuracy or missing-site correction; C718/C719 exclusions are explicit in site panel.

decision: Do not publish a separated conventional multinomial fit
rationale: The old NOMREG has Hessian warnings; zero overlapping outcomes in four nonreference ethnicity groups produce no-finite-MLE directions.
support_type: Saved warning plus local mathematical certificate
limitations: No conventional four-outcome estimates or p-values are manufactured; binary Firth is not misapplied to it.

decision: Specify adult reference and smaller primary adjustment
rationale: Use age18-44 reference; age sex sector year primary; all ethnicity categories descriptive and added in extended sensitivity models.
support_type: Study specification supported by cell audit
limitations: No significance-driven pooling; exploratory associations and incomplete confounding control.

decision: Expose temporal sensitivity and sparse uncertainty
rationale: Use matched-row residence adjustment, age-group definition checks, HC0 and supplementary profile intervals.
support_type: Local validation and asymptotic interval method
limitations: Pediatric contrasts change by period; repeated records facility dependence and nonrandom site recording unresolved.

decision: Regenerate Tables 1–2 with explicit denominators and scoped residence
rationale: Column composition and within-category fatality answer different questions; only residence blocks restrict to verified 2018–2024.
support_type: Reporting principle and explicit study choice
limitations: Early residence labels remain unresolved; counts represent admissions rather than unique patients.

decision: Dispatch exploratory independence tests by active-cell sparsity
rationale: Conservative Pearson observed/expected >=5 rule; sparse 2x2 Fisher; other sparse tables fixed-margin Monte Carlo Pearson with recorded seeds and uncertainty.
support_type: Documented numerical procedures plus implementation choice
limitations: No multiplicity adjustment or clustering correction. Minimum attainable simulation p is not an exact p or upper bound.

decision: Use shared self-contained model legends without refitting
rationale: State events, covariates, sample sizes, references and Wald methods; translate labels and preserve numeric results and p precision.
limitations: Legends do not establish independent observations or causal effects; manuscript insertion remains T07.

decision: Rewrite study framing and Methods from executed reconstruction
rationale: Distinguish C71 primary discharge diagnosis from primary tumour origin; explain all analysis populations and do not reuse invalid historical estimates.
limitations: Replacement sections are prepared; original whole-paper consistency awaits T08–T09 integration. Ethics and author declarations remain unverified.

decision: Generate manuscript numbers from a traceability ledger
rationale: Insert raw aggregate values with declared rounding, preserving source locators and exact input fingerprints; accept only demonstrated line-ending transformations across systems.
limitations: Hash identity and number matching do not establish clinical accuracy, independence or absence of bias.

decision: Use page-verified reporting crosswalk and preserve newly observed Word provenance
rationale: Report covered versus open STROBE/RECORD items using rendered section pages; record newly observed unmanifested Word file separately from original six-input baseline.
limitations: Page references apply to replacement sections only; Word repagination requires rechecking. Baseline Word version/equivalence and full-paper compliance are not established.

decision: Replace unsupported narrative with claim-specific evidence and explicit uncertainty
rationale: Separate recorded service events, mortality denominators, conditional anatomy and unmeasured mechanisms; remove firstness, stability and causal clinical/sector claims.
support_type: Local result interpretation and source-limited context
limitations: No clinical diagnosis validation or causal care comparison; full-paper integration and figures remain pending.

decision: Freeze exact GLOBOCAN 2024 v1.0 artifact and retain verified numbers as estimates
rationale: Archived Ecuador fact sheet page2 Brain CNS confirms561 new cases/463 deaths; release label September2026 and access12November2026; explicit methods identify modelled endpoints.
limitations: Current snapshot does not establish old July2026 endpoint contents; cancer estimates are not C71 hospital counts or comparable rate denominators.

decision: Disposition every historical reference and narrow active citations to verified claims
rationale: Collapse duplicate original CBTRUS identities; normalize known DOI suffixes; distinguish full-text classification review from abstract-only regional-method support; remove numerical international hospital benchmarking.
limitations: No blanket full-text validation of discarded sources or exhaustive novelty search; no DOI invented for an unverified reference.

decision: Rebuild Figure1 from exact Table3 primary rows with explicit uncertainty
rationale: Prevent table/plot drift; plot all components and total with consistent shapes/colours and total95% shading; retain all component intervals.
support_type: Executed source equality and export implementation
limitations: Independent-event/fixed-denominator intervals omit systematic error and dependence; no trend or causal COVID test.

decision: Define residence counts as primary geography and facility counts separately
rationale: Differentiate origin from service location; use source INEC codes to unify accent variants and preserve zeros; exclude only three foreign records from residence.
support_type: Source-variable meanings and independent count reconciliation
limitations: Admissions not unique persons or population risk; early rural labels unused; registration completeness not proven.

decision: Use readable count heatmaps plus fixed-boundary supplementary atlas
rationale: Full province labels remain legible at180mm while maps share one0–500 scale; archive exact boundary metadata/object hashes and explicit name/code crosswalk.
support_type: Primary cartographic artifact, versioned data and visual QA
limitations: 2011 representation is not validated annual geometry; source duplicate ISO not used; longitude/latitude view and repositioned inset do not support area/distance inference.
